title: Jilla
desc: Shakthi, the adopted son of Sivan, is a powerful gangster in Madurai. Although Shakthi bitterly hates the police, he is forced to become a policeman at his father's behest.

title: Ustaad
desc: Parmeshwaran leaves behind a life of crime and goes to his hometown with his sister Padmaja. But the demons of his past life come back to haunt him after Padmaja falls in love with a boy.

title: Loham
desc: When Jayanthi's husband, Ramesh, who is accused in a gold smuggling case, goes missing, she comes to Kochi to find him. In her quest to locate him, she comes across Raju, a taxi driver.

title: Rudrangi
desc: Bheem Rao Deshmukh, a tyrant who oppresses his people, is drawn to a beautiful woman named Rudrangi and desires physical contact with her. In order to satisfy his obsession, he terrorises her village.

title: Bhai
desc: A ruthless crime lord's plan to eliminate a police officer backfires when the henchman assigned to kill him discovers the target is his long-lost brother.
